opportunities.name: JetBlue flight search with sort & filter
opportunities.description: Search JetBlue flights from an origin to a destination for given trip type and dates, then open Sort & Filter and sort the results (e.g. price low to high), optionally showing points.
steps: Open jetblue.com Flights tab
Set trip type (Roundtrip / One-way) if needed
Type origin in From and pick the suggested airport/city area
Type destination in To and pick the suggested airport
Open Depart calendar and pick departure date
Pick return date if roundtrip
Optionally tick 'Use TrueBlue points'
Click Search flights and confirm 'Continue to flight results' if prompted
Optionally toggle Dollars/Points
Click Sort & Filter, open Sort dropdown, choose price sort, click Apply

instances.values: New York JFK -> Miami MIA, roundtrip Mar 27-Mar 31, points view, sort Price by Core
New York City area (NYC) -> Toronto YYZ, one-way Apr 29, sort Price (low to high)
New York City area (NYC) -> Aruba AUA, roundtrip May 1-May 5, use TrueBlue points, sort Price (low to high)

opportunities.name: Avis Budget Group careers job search with filters
opportunities.description: From budget.com go to Careers > Openings, filter jobs by country, team and time type, run the search, and open/apply to a matching job.
steps: On budget.com footer click Careers
Click Openings
Open Country filter, search and select country
Open Team filter, search and select team
Open Time Type filter, select time type
Click SEARCH BY JOB TITLE OR KEYWORD
Optionally open a job posting and click APPLY NOW

instances.values: Country United States of America, Team Finance, Full time; opened Accounts Payable Associate and clicked Apply Now
Country United States of America, Team Finance, Full time (search run, no application)

opportunities.name: United car rental search
opportunities.description: On united.com Book > Car, enter a pickup location, pickup/drop-off dates and optionally times and Book with miles, then click Find cars.
steps: Open united.com and click the CAR tab under Book
Optionally toggle Book with miles
Type pickup location and select the suggestion
Open Pickup date calendar, pick pickup date and drop-off date
Optionally set pickup time and drop-off time
Click Find cars

instances.values: Caldwell (Ohio), US; Apr 8-Apr 13; 8:00 a.m. - 12:00 p.m.; book with miles
Brooklyn - Central (New York), US; Apr 9-Apr 15; default 10:00 a.m. times

opportunities.name: NPS Find a Park by activity or topic
opportunities.description: On nps.gov go to Find a Park > Search by Activity or Topic, select an activity or topic in the filter dropdown, and run the search.
steps: Click FIND A PARK
Click 'Search by Activity or Topic'
Open the Activity or Topic dropdown
Check the desired activity/topic option
Click Search

opportunities.name: MTA bridges & tunnels toll rates by vehicle
opportunities.description: On new.mta.info navigate to Bridges & Tunnels tolls > Tolls by vehicle and open the toll rates for a given vehicle type.
steps: Navigate to Bridges & Tunnels tolls (via Menu > Agencies > Bridges & Tunnels, or Fares & Tolls > Bridges and Tunnels tolls)
Open Toll Rates / Tolls by vehicle
Click the vehicle type (Cars, Motorcycles, Trucks)
Review the rates for the relevant crossing

opportunities.name: Retail product search with max price and add to cart
opportunities.description: Search a retailer for a keyword, apply a maximum price filter, pick a product and add it to the cart.
steps: Type the product keyword in the site search box and search
Enter the maximum price in the price filter and click Go
Optionally apply an extra filter
Open/choose a product from results
Click Add to Cart

instances.values: Menards: 'swivel vacuum', max $150, added Shepherd swivel caster wheel to cart
Amazon: 'wireless headphones', max $100, Active Noise Cancellation filter, added EAORUL headphones to cart
